name: Spectral Exciter
description: OP0 is a hub node that sums three excitation sources (OP1-3, AUDIO edges) and is additionally phase-modulated by OP4. Written as a forward-looking template for Engine Type 8 (resonator, see docs/ROADMAP.md Phase 10) -- today the exciter/hub node just runs the Classic engine, but the routing shape (multiple audio sources feeding one hub, plus a modulator) is exactly what a resonator patch will want once that engine ships.
